title: Evaluation of Retinal Ganglion Cell via Visual Evoked Potential.
abstract: Visual Evoked Potential (VEP) is an electrical signal recorded from the visual cortex in response to light stimulation. It can be used as an in vivo method to objectively access the functional integrity of the retinogeniculocortical pathway. Here we describe the methods to perform flash VEP (FVEP) recording in rodents and goat and pattern VEP (PVEP) recording in rhesus macaque.
